content:
Samir: Heads up — Swivel wants to POC Redwood as a drop-in replacement for CompetitorX. Their Sellers asked for prompt parity, identical billing behavior, and minimal changes to client code. Timeline: 2-week POC, kickoff next Monday.
Leah: great. can we offer a sandbox with IP allowlist + staging creds? they asked for SSO + KMS for legal.
Samir: NDA's signed. @Theo can you spin up a sandbox + private control-plane preview? prefer Dedicated small pool so latency is stable. :white_check_mark:
Theo: I can. need origin IPs + expected qps. also need to map their model name — what variant do they use?
Samir: CompetitorX defaults to `compx-13b` with a lot of system-prompt templating + streaming completions. they also rely on function-calling schema.
Leah: buyer Qs summary: 1) prompt fidelity when we rewrite system prompts 2) response normalization (function call vs inline) 3) tokenization delta and billing impact 4) security questionnaire answers + SOC artifacts
Priya: i'm on sec Qs. send the vendor questionnaire and the list of required artifacts. we may need to offer BYO-KMS for enterprise legal.
Samir: uploaded their questionnaire here: https://redwood.share/swivel/compx-vendor-qna.json
Theo: for parity, recommend a compatibility shim that: (a) rewrites incoming prompts to Redwood templates, (b) normalizes function-calling payloads, (c) records token deltas. we'll provide a small shim lib and a test-harness with 500 representative prompts.
Leah: pricing: they expect price parity. if tokenization causes a token increase, do we offer a temporary rebate? they want predictable unit economics during the POC.
Samir: propose a conditional credit: if avg token delta > 8% over 30 days, give a 10% credit on token charges for first 3 months. keeps sales competitive.
Priya: security flags from legal: logs retained <30 days, strict access controls, dedicated key control, and evidence of encryption in transit+at-rest. we can meet this on Private; Hosted needs contract addendum.
Theo: SE notes on edge cases: streamed completions may differ when model truncates mid-function-call; signature names for function calls can vary. we'll include a conversion layer in the shim and a fallback policy to route to compx (via proxy) when divergence > threshold.
Samir: action items: @Theo provision sandbox + supply sample mapping and shim repo by EOD tomorrow; @Priya complete sec Q answers + SOC2 summary by EOD Friday; @Leah draft POC SOW including pricing credit + SLOs. i'll schedule kickoff and invite Swivel.
Leah: also confirm SLOs for Dedicated pool (p50/p95 latency targets) and burst capacity policy. they may require 99.9% availability in contract. :rocket:
secbot: SOC2 summary uploaded to shared drive and legal notified. Automated note: artifact `SOC2-summary-2025.pdf` available.
Samir: thanks — i'll follow up with a one-pager for the customer and attach the shim repo link once ready.
